series.name: Exports of goods and services
series.definition: Value of all goods and market services provided to the rest of the world, including merchandise, freight, insurance, travel, and other services.

series.name: Imports of goods and services
series.definition: Value of all goods and market services received from the rest of the world.

series.name: Gross Domestic Product (GDP)
series.definition: Sum of gross value added by all resident producers in the economy plus any product taxes minus subsidies.

series.name: Official Exchange Rate (INR / USD)
series.units: Indian Rupee per US Dollar (annual period average)
series.definition: Official exchange rate determined by national authorities or rate in the legally sanctioned exchange market.

series.name: Consumer Price Index (CPI) Inflation
series.definition: Annual percentage change in the cost to the average consumer of acquiring a basket of goods and services.

series.name: Trade as share of GDP
series.definition: Sum of exports and imports of goods and services measured as a share of gross domestic product.

sources.name: Directorate General of Commercial Intelligence and Statistics (DGCI&S)
sources.publisher: Department of Commerce, Ministry of Commerce and Industry, Government of India
sources.retrieval_method: Official Trade Statistics / EIDB Data Bank

series.name: Bilateral Direction of Trade
series.definition: Total merchandise exports, imports, and trade balance disaggregated by partner country across major global economies.

series.name: Principal Commodity Group Trade
series.definition: Trade values broken down by major sectors (Petroleum, Electronics, Engineering, Gems & Jewellery, Chemicals, Agriculture, etc.).

sources.name: Reserve Bank of India (RBI) Database on Indian Economy
sources.retrieval_method: Monthly Bulletin and External Sector Foreign Trade Statistics

series.name: Monthly Merchandise Trade
series.definition: Monthly merchandise exports, imports, non-oil exports, and oil imports facilitating high-frequency trend and volatility analysis.
